scripts.build:patch: npm version patch -m "chore: bump version to %s" && next build && git push && git push --tags
scripts.build:minor: npm version minor -m "chore: bump version to %s" && next build && git push && git push --tags
scripts.build:major: npm version major -m "chore: bump version to %s" && next build && git push && git push --tags
scripts.docker:push: docker push internal.sansenshimizu.com/isf/frontend:$(npm run version --silent) && docker push internal.sansenshimizu.com/isf/frontend:latest
scripts.release:dev: npm run build && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push
scripts.release:patch: npm run build:patch && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push
scripts.release:minor: npm run build:minor && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push
scripts.release:major: npm run build:major && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push
